layers.process: Udzungwa Mountains National Park: Groups entering forest routes should register at the gate and hire an authorised guide where required. Stay on designated trails; swimming is only at signed pools when safe. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.
Udzungwa Mountains National Park: Special campsites require advance reservation; separate charges may apply for camping and guiding. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.

Mikumi National Park: Walking must be with an authorised ranger or guide. Stay in the vehicle except at designated points or on an authorised guided walk. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.
Mikumi National Park: Special campsites require advance reservation. Confirm current arrangements directly with the park.

laws.rule: Mikumi National Park: Remain in the vehicle except in designated areas or on an authorised guided walk. Do not feed wildlife; keep to tracks. Special campsites are pre-booked. Gate hours end at dusk in the guide, with no exact clock time given.

Udzungwa Mountains National Park: Register forest routes at the gate and hire an authorised guide where required; the guide does not say every route has identical guide conditions. Use designated trails and swim only at signed pools when conditions are safe. Special camps require advance booking.
